title: Spanish Short Stories
author: E. C. Hills and L. Reinhardt (eds.)
note: Spanish Short Stories (Hills and Reinhardt, 1910): 14 stories by different writers, each starting at its title in capitals after the introduction; authors from the contents page. Each story's 'POR DON ...' byline, the footnote markers ({9-1}), part numbers and subtitles in capitals are dropped, and so are the English notes and the vocabulary (the text ends at NOTES).
